registrationRules.crossProductDiscovery: Products query the shared registry by capability and platform tags; they must not maintain divergent copies of agent identity.
registrationRules.agentExecution: Only registered and available agents may be dispatched.
registrationRules.approval: High-impact actions require explicit human approval; approval cannot be inferred from an agent recommendation.
